camel_example: aliyun gpdb Rerank --region cn-hangzhou --TopK 3 --MaxChunksPerDoc 10 --Instruct 'Given_a_web_search_query,_retrieve_relevant_passages_that_answer_the_query' --Query What_is_ADBPG0 --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --ReturnDocuments false --Documents '["ADBPG是阿里云OLAP数据库。"]' --Model 'bge-reranker-v2-m3' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: The Rerank operation can resolve the issue of inaccurate ranking of vector and full-text search results. It re-scores and reranks the retrieved data through semantic understanding to significantly improve the relevance and accuracy of the results. AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL allows you to rerank search results by using Rerank models, but does not provide models
description_zh:
Rerank能够解决向量检索和全文检索结果排序不精准的问题，通过语义理解对召回数据重新打分排序，显著提升结果的相关性与准确性。
AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL版支持调用Rerank模型对检索结果做重排，但不提供模型
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb rerank --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --query What_is_ADBPG0 --documents ADBPG是阿里云OLAP数据库。 --model bge-reranker-v2-m3 --instruct Given_a_web_search_query,_retrieve_relevant_passages_that_answer_the_query --topk 3 --return-documents false --max-chunks-per-doc 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Rerank

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html API to view details of all AnalyticDB PostgreSQL instances in the target region, including the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: Region ID where the instance is located
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.example: ADBPG is an Alibaba Cloud OLAP database.
parameters.help_en: List of documents to be re-ordered
parameters.help_zh: 要重新排序的文档列表
parameters.name: documents

parameters.help_en:
Rerank model, currently supports:
bge-reranker-v2-m3: (default), better performance, supports 8192 tokens per inference, if exceeded, it will be split, which may reduce the effect.
bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise: better performance than v2-m3, supports 2048 tokens per inference, if exceeded, it will be split, which may reduce the effect
parameters.help_zh:
Rerank模型，目前支持
bge-reranker-v2-m3:（默认值），性能较好，单条推理支持8192tokens，超出会被切分，效果可能下降。
bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise：效果相比v2-m3更优，单条推理支持2048tokens，超出会被切分，效果可能下降
parameters.name: model

parameters.example: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
parameters.name: instruct

parameters.help_en: Number of most relevant documents to return
parameters.help_zh: 要返回的最相关文档的数量
parameters.name: topk

parameters.help_en: If set to false, does not return the Documents text, only returns the index of the document order and the rerank score
parameters.help_zh: 为false时，不返回Documents文本，仅仅返回文档排序的索引及rerank得分
parameters.name: return_documents

parameters.help_en:
Maximum number of chunks allowed when the text exceeds the model window:
bge-reranker-v2-m3: default value is 10.
bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise: default value is 5:

Example of splitting
If using the bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise model, the maximum single inference window is 2048 tokens. If the query is 48 tokens and the content of a single document parameter is 9000 tokens, it will be divided as follows: 1-2000 for the first, 2001-4000 for the second, and so on. If the number of splits exceeds MaxChunksPerDoc, the remaining sentences will be discarded
parameters.help_zh:
超出模型窗口时，允许将文本切分的最大块数：
bge-reranker-v2-m3：默认值是10。
bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise：默认值是5：

切分举例
如果使用bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise模型，则最大单推理窗口为2048tokens，此时如果query是48tokens，单个document参数内容为9000tokens，则会被分为：1-2000为第一个，2001-4000为第二个，以此类推，并且切分个数超过MaxChunksPerDoc后，后面的语句会被丢弃
parameters.name: max_chunks_per_doc
